offeredEvidence.quote: TRANSACTION COST EXPEDITE FEE $0.01-$14.99 $3.00 $15.00-$24.99 $3.50 $25.00-$84.99 $6.00 $85.00-$149.99 $10.00 $150.00-$499.00 $15.00 $500.00 $20.00 Over $500 4.5 % of the fi ling fee Expedited Cost Associated with Fax and Electronic Filings

notes: Massachusetts uses the words 'expedite fee', but what it prices is a channel, not a turnaround: the fee schedule's own section, 'Expedited Cost Associated with Fax and Electronic Filings', is a table that scales the charge to the transaction cost ($3 on a filing under $15, $20 on a $500 filing, 4.5% above $500) and attaches it to filing by fax or electronically. Nowhere in the 43-page schedule is any turnaround promised for it  -  the document contains no 'expedited service', 'same day' or hour-based commitment for filings. Recording this as a tier would make it look comparable to states that sell a clock, so the honest shape is offered: false with the channel surcharge explained here. For the LLC Certificate of Organization the schedule reads '$500.00' by mail or hand delivery and '$500.00 plus $20.00 expedite fee' when fax filed, and the electronically-filed column for the domestic LLC section carries the same '$500.00 plus $20.00 expedite fee'. Quotes reproduce the PDF text layer's own artifacts (the 'fi' ligature drops: 'Certifi cate', 'fi ling') because the mechanical check compares against the same extraction.

A browser session could check whether the Corporations Division publishes a processing-time figure.
